page.description: Parrot OS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A Debian-based security and privacy distribution with KDE Plasma, offering Security (700+ pentesting tools), Home (daily use), HTB, LXQt, MATE, Enlightenment spins, LXQt, MATE and Enlightenment desktop spins, plus amd64v3-tuned variants for modern CPUs.
pros: SHA-256 checksums published in PGP-clearsigned signed-hashes.txt
Eight amd64 editions including tuned builds for modern CPUs
Live mode with optional persistence via mkusb
cons: Digests come from the one signed-hashes.txt list, not per-file sidecars
Tuned images target amd64v3 (Haswell/Excavator+) — incompatible with older CPUs
Some formats (OVA, QCOW2, VMDK) are VM-only and cannot be written to USB
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Parrot OS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the ISOHybrid ISO to USB with Etcher, Rufus (DD mode), or dd. The Calamares installer installs to disk. Live mode available with optional persistent partition.
